let W_START = datetime(2026-08-16);
let W_END   = datetime(2026-09-15);
let cat =
    external_table('gold_plume_catalog')
    | where detection_date >= W_START and detection_date < W_END
    | where isnotempty(attributed_facility_id)
    | extend d = bin(detection_date, 1d)
    | summarize cat_plumes = count(), cat_kg = sum(ime_kg)
        by facility_id = attributed_facility_id, d;
let snap =
    external_table('fact_facility_daily_snapshot')
    | where snapshot_date >= W_START and snapshot_date < W_END
    | where active_plumes > 0
    | summarize snap_plumes = sum(active_plumes), snap_kg = sum(total_emissions_kg)
        by facility_id, d = bin(snapshot_date, 1d);
cat
| join kind=fullouter snap on facility_id, d
| extend verdict = case(
    isnull(cat_plumes), "snapshot_only",
    isnull(snap_plumes), "catalog_only",
    cat_plumes != snap_plumes, "plume_count_differs",
    abs(cat_kg - snap_kg) > 1.0, "kg_differs",
    "match")
| summarize n = count() by verdict
